moments.title: The Huge Gap in Brain Science Nobody Talks About
moments.insight: Victor argues science understands the brain deeply, but that knowledge rarely reaches the public.

moments.title: Born From Rome: How Rhetoric Became a Business Framework
moments.insight: He traces his 'neuroinductive practice' framework back to political science, psychology, and cognitive neuroscience.

moments.title: The Paradigm Shift That Defines Successful CEOs
moments.insight: Victor says success isn't about what you have, but the benefit-link you create for your interlocutor.

moments.title: Why AI Isn't Really Intelligence
moments.insight: He claims AI only parameterizes data into averages, lacking the specificity true human intelligence provides in persuasion.

moments.title: Betting Big on Brain-Machine Interfaces
moments.insight: Victor reveals he's been investing in BMI since its inception, predicting brain-tech integration will become 'the new normal.'

moments.title: Inside EVIS: The RNA Biotech Bet
moments.insight: He describes investing in EVIS, a company loading RNA into extracellular vesicles as the body's natural messengers.
